title: statusline r3 A11y: field absence has no worded-never-silent contract
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 3. Lens: accessibility (validator: ux). Owner: SO session. Defect: degradation and truncation are worded-never-silent but sessionless/milestone-less absence states can render as empty slots — silent position-only absence passes every listed check; the segment's own principle applied unevenly. Citations verified: contract:160, :185. Proposed: deferred-candidate, foldable one-sentence fix (absent fields render as worded absence).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree (deferred folded). Worded-absence contract added: a display field whose value is absent renders a worded absence, never an empty slot — never-silent covers absence, degradation, and truncation alike; sessionless and milestone-less fixtures verify it. Revision: Status bullet + Status detection criterion.
